ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely high ratio of low-intensity (black) pixels to high-intensity (white) pixels; dark pigmentation covers approximately 95% of the visible surface with white pixels restricted to lateral tips and sparse spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous solid dark field across both lobes. High-contrast contiguous white geometric blobs are localized at the extreme lateral left and right tips. Sparse, stochastic high-intensity points are scattered across the mid-ventral dark field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 110 degrees and a vertical depth ratio of roughly 1:8 relative to total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude jagged serrations (5-12 pixel amplitude) present at both lateral tips; the trailing edge between the tips and the notch shows low-amplitude, irregular micro-peaks and valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primary trailing edge curve is concave from the median notch to the outer tips; the outer lateral edges exhibit a sharp posterior-oriented sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, irregular clusters of high-intensity pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized at the far left and right extremities. Small, discrete circular white clusters scattered throughout the dark lobe surfaces.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single, prominent horizontal-linear pixel disruption (white rake mark/scratch) visible on the medial-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant physical encrustations and associated scarring at both lateral tips creating a jagged boundary; distinct linear abrasion on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive contrast between the nearly uniform dark central pigmentation and the heavily textured, white-flecked lateral extremities.
